primary_diagnosis_treated: Essential hypertension (chronic primary hypertension) in pregnancy

medications.dose: Start 100 mg orally twice daily; increase by 100 mg per dose every 2–3 days as needed to max 200 mg twice daily (≈2 g/day)
medications.nice_justification: First‑line antihypertensive safe in pregnancy per NICE NG136

medications.dose: 1 tablet orally once daily (or every other day to improve absorption) with vitamin C
medications.duration: Until ferritin >200 µg/L (≈3 months), then review
medications.nice_justification: Standard anemia management; iron supplementation recommended when Hb low (NICE guidance)

medications.dose: 500 mg orally every 6 hours as needed, maximum 3 g per day
medications.purpose: Safe analgesia for chronic low‑back pain, replace NSAID component
medications.nice_justification: Analgesic of choice in pregnancy (NICE obstetric guidance)

interactions_checked.interaction: Additive hypotensive effect; risk of symptomatic hypotension
NSAIDs may blunt antihypertensive response and increase renal risk

contraindications.reason: ACE inhibitor contraindicated in pregnancy (teratogenic) – NICE NG136
contraindications.alternative: Stop lisinopril; use labetalol, methyldopa or extended‑release nifedipine

contraindications.reason: NSAIDs contraindicated in pregnancy after 20 weeks and with hypertension – NICE NG136
contraindications.alternative: Use acetaminophen for pain; consider physiotherapy

assumptions_warnings: Gestational age not provided; assumed patient is beyond first trimester, therefore ACE‑I and NSAID are contraindicated.
eGFR not provided; creatinine 1.1 mg/dL suggests near‑normal renal function, but renal function will be checked before and after starting antihypertensive.
Allergy status unknown; will confirm no β‑blocker allergy before prescribing labetalol.
Baseline liver function tests not available; required before initiating methyldopa if labetalol not tolerated.
Fetal growth monitoring plan not detailed; obstetric ultrasound will be arranged at 28 weeks and as per local protocol.
treatment_summary: Stop lisinopril and ibuprofen immediately. Initiate labetalol 100 mg BID with titration to control stage‑2 hypertension, aiming for <140/90 mmHg. Provide iron supplementation for anemia and acetaminophen for pain relief. Monitor blood pressure, renal function, electrolytes, and fetal growth each trimester. Arrange opioid taper, physiotherapy for back pain, and regular antenatal follow‑up.
